status: Conditional catalogue-proxy budget; hardware supplier/preload selection remains open

guides.preload: HG15C ZA; Z0 and ZB bound the catalogue radial stiffness
guides.assumption: HG15C is a catalogue proxy for the unselected HGR15-compatible blocks; the same stiffness in both transverse directions is an assumed equivalent. No along-rail spring.

drives.preload: R16-5B1 FDI double nut, 10% dynamic load; 32.4 kgf/um times 9.80665
drives.bearingLocation: HIWIN manufacturer catalogue, rigidity table (DF: 0.75 kN/um)
drives.assumption: FDI nut and 15 mm support pair are stiffness proxies, not drop-in SFU1605/BK12 selections. Shaft root diameter is the R16-5B1 catalogue proxy. Fixed-to-nut length comes from packet COM separation; bearing/nut housing deformation is omitted.
drives.shaftModulusSource: frame-study.json materials entry keyed by each screw part MaterialLibrary ID

beltX.status: Existing code assumption, not measured catalogue stiffness for the molded belt
beltX.catalogueProxyLocation: HTD5 15 mm open-ended/welded belt: aramid and steel SL specific stiffness
beltX.assumption: Two pretensioned equal straight spans; no slack, tooth compliance or motor/servo wind-up. Gates cord constructions are different products and only a sensitivity proxy. Ktheta=2*EA*r^2/span; kAxial=Ktheta*(2*pi/lead)^2.

columnClamp.source: Explicit study bracket; no clamp preload/contact measurement exists
columnClamp.assumption: Four discrete pad springs; CAD pad stiffness is already in FEM. These springs add contact compliance only; closed, sticking contact assumed.

spindleBearings.assumption: Catalogue proxy, not selected BT30 cartridge internals. Pair radial stiffness is split equally over two assumed stations; axial pair stiffness acts at the front station. No shaft bending; spin about Z carries no cutting torque in this force-only budget.

toolHolder.source: MillPowerDrawbarPart holder geometry and packet material ID; E from matching frame-study.json material. Taper contact springs are explicit study assumptions.
toolHolder.assumption: Uniform annular neck beam plus assumed taper translation/rotation; no claim of measured holder rigidity. Tool stick-out is read from packet bounds.

tool.source: Packet steel tool material ID and geometry; modulus from matching frame-study.json material; flute inertia fraction is an explicit study assumption
tool.assumption: Steel cutter matching the CAD material assignment; cantilever from holder nose, effective bending inertia half the circular section and solid axial area. A carbide tool requires an explicit material override.

supports.source: The selected FEM support configuration and SUPPORT_SPRINGS strain energy
supports.assumption: Support compliance is already in frame FEM; split it out by energy, never add the same support in series again.

steel.source: Explicit study assumption, nominal steel modulus; matches machined-steel baseline

carbide.source: Explicit sensitivity assumption for cemented carbide; grade/binder-dependent, not a selected tool specification

toolMaterials.source: Explicit elastic-modulus sensitivity assumptions, per material below
